text: 一个巨大的毛茸茸身影蹒跚着出现在你面前。起初你把它当成大猩猩；再看一眼，人类学家的眼光便认出这是一个从未有科学描述的物种。此时最恰当的做法是递给它食物，表示友好。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 493
text: A gigantic hairy shape shuffles out before you. At first, you mistake it for a gorilla—but at second glance, your anthropologist’s eye marks it as a species never before described scientifically. The appropriate action here is to offer it food as a gesture of friendship.
